snippet.title: OneShot Challenge - Official Demo Trailer #indie #games
snippet.description:
Play the demo now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4112690/One_Shot_Challenge/

OneShot Challenge is a roguelike built around a simple but intense idea: you only have one bullet.

Redirect your bullet with your frying pan, survive unpredictable rooms, create powerful builds, and face dangerous enemies in a fast-paced and challenging combat system where every move matters.

Adapt your strategy, master your timing, and fight your way through relentless encounters.

The demo is available now on Steam. Wishlist the game and experience the challenge.

Wishlist OneShot Challenge on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4112690/One_Shot_Challenge/
